_meta.description: Phase 4 of the marketing programme: the campaign that owns the UTM vocabulary and its landing page, and the touchpoint log attribution is computed from. Also adds campaignId to blast, firstTouch and lastTouch to lead, and campaignId, touchpointIds, invoiceRef and model to attributionLink, all additive. socialPost is phase 3 and is deliberately not declared here; campaign.postIds holds its references as plain ids until that schema lands.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.summary: One marketing campaign: the mailings, posts and landing page that share a campaign value.
campaign.description: A campaign groups everything that carries one utm_campaign value, so two mailings and a post report as one campaign instead of three. utmCampaign is minted from the name on the first save by CampaignService and never changes afterwards, because the value is already written into portaliq's daily rollups and into links that have left the building. utmSource and utmMedium are lowercase and come from the vocabularies in the app-config values campaign.utm_sources and campaign.utm_mediums, which an administrator maintains. The landingPage block is written by LandingPageProvisioningService from what portaliq answers; pipelinq never renders the page itself (ADR-086).

name.title: Name
name.description: What the campaign is called, as the marketer writes it.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: What this campaign is meant to achieve, in one sentence.
goal.example: Vijftig aanmeldingen voor het webinar van 12 november.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the campaign is in its own life.

utmCampaign.title: Campaign value
utmCampaign.description: The utm_campaign value every link in this campaign carries. Minted from the name once and frozen; renaming the campaign leaves it alone.

utmSource.title: Source
utmSource.description: The utm_source value, lowercase, from the vocabulary in campaign.utm_sources. Linkedin and linkedin are two campaigns in every analytics tool, so the case rule is enforced rather than corrected.

utmMedium.title: Medium
utmMedium.description: The utm_medium value, lowercase, from the vocabulary in campaign.utm_mediums.

mailingIds.title: Mailings
mailingIds.description: The blasts that belong to this campaign. A blast also names its campaign, so the list is a convenience for the report, not the truth.

postIds.title: Posts
postIds.description: The social posts that belong to this campaign. Plain ids until phase 3 ships the socialPost schema.

landingPage.title: Landing page
landingPage.description: What portaliq answered when this campaign asked for a page. Written by LandingPageProvisioningService, never by hand.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: The portal slug the page was created on.

route.title: Route
route.description: The in-portal route, as portaliq echoed it back.

publicUrl.title: Public URL
publicUrl.description: Where a visitor reaches the page. Empty when the portal has no domain configured.

formRef.title: Form
formRef.description: The portaliq form bound to the landing page. A submission on this form becomes a lead in this campaign.

articleSummary.title: Page summary
articleSummary.description: The summary the landing page opens with. Portaliq refuses an empty one.

articleBody.example:
## Programma

- Wat AI vandaag wel en niet kan
- Drie toepassingen bij gemeenten
- Vragen

startsAt.title: Starts at
startsAt.description: First day of the campaign. The report window opens here.

endsAt.title: Ends at
endsAt.description: Last day of the campaign. The report window closes here.

budgetEur.title: Budget
budgetEur.description: What the campaign was allowed to cost, in euro.

costs.title: Costs
costs.description: What the campaign actually cost, per channel, as far as anyone recorded it. A channel that is absent is reported as not recorded, never as zero: zero reads as free.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The channel the spend belongs to.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: How this campaign's report divides value. The models are computed at report time from the touchpoint log; nothing here is a stored answer.

model.title: Default model
model.description: The model the report opens on.

windowDays.title: Window
windowDays.description: How many days after the last touchpoint a close still counts.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: The user who created the campaign. Set by the server, never by the browser.

touchpoint.title: Touchpoint
touchpoint.summary: One attributable interaction between a person and a campaign.
touchpoint.description: The ledger the attribution models read. A touchpoint is written when someone clicks a link in a mailing, lands on a campaign page, submits its form or replies. Attribution is computed over these rows at report time and is never written back, so a model can change without rewriting history. The nonce carries the id portaliq stamped on a form submission and is what makes the submission listener idempotent: a redelivered submission finds its own touchpoint and writes nothing.

campaignId.title: Campaign
campaignId.description: The campaign this interaction belongs to.

contactId.title: Contact
contactId.description: Who interacted, when we know. Empty for an anonymous visit.

leadId.title: Lead
leadId.description: The lead this interaction contributed to, when there is one.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Which channel carried it, resolved from the medium.

utm.title: UTM
utm.description: The campaign parameters this interaction carried.

content.title: Content
content.description: The utm_content value, which is the blast id for a mailing.

sourceRef.title: Source object
sourceRef.description: The blast, post or page that caused the interaction.

occurredAt.title: Occurred at
occurredAt.description: When it happened, to the second or better. Rows with the same moment keep the order they were written in, so a report is reproducible.

nonce.title: Nonce
nonce.description: The id the producing system stamped on this interaction. Portaliq stamps one per form submission; the submission listener refuses to act twice on the same value.

campaignId.title: Campaign
campaignId.description: The campaign this blast belongs to. When set, the campaign's source, medium and campaign value are stamped on every link instead of the per-blast defaults.

firstTouch.title: First touch
firstTouch.description: The campaign parameters of the visit that first brought this person to the site, captured at form submission.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The utm_campaign value at first touch.

source.title: Source
source.description: The utm_source value at first touch.

medium.title: Medium
medium.description: The utm_medium value at first touch.

term.title: Term
term.description: The utm_term value at first touch.

content.title: Content
content.description: The utm_content value at first touch.

lastTouch.title: Last touch
lastTouch.description: The campaign parameters of the visit the form was submitted on.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The utm_campaign value at last touch.

source.title: Source
source.description: The utm_source value at last touch.

medium.title: Medium
medium.description: The utm_medium value at last touch.

term.title: Term
term.description: The utm_term value at last touch.

content.title: Content
content.description: The utm_content value at last touch.

campaignId.title: Campaign
campaignId.description: The campaign that produced this lead.

campaignId.title: Campaign
campaignId.description: The campaign the attributed value belongs to.

touchpointIds.title: Touchpoints
touchpointIds.description: The touchpoints the value was divided over.

invoiceRef.title: Invoice
invoiceRef.description: The shillinq AR invoice this value closed on, when it closed on a paid invoice rather than on a won lead. Pipelinq reads the invoice and never books it (ADR-107).

model.title: Model
model.description: Which attribution model produced this row.
